title: Multi-phase production with scrap, rework capacity, and final quality constraint
text: A factory produces 89 items per day for 31 days with defect rate 0.232. Defectives can be reworked at capacity 37 items/day with success probability 0.888; unreworked defectives are scrapped and failed reworks are scrapped. For the next 9 days, production increases to 101 and the defect rate is 0.293 unless cumulative scrap first exceeds 60. Starting in phase 2, whenever cumulative scrap first exceeds 60, the defect rate switches to 0.281 from the next day onward, and an inspection cost of 2984 is incurred for each remaining day. Find the expected number of sellable items and the expected total inspection cost.
